title: Linear Algebra Intuition
motto: Every AI model is just matrix math wearing a fancy hat.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Every AI model is just matrix math wearing a fancy hat.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Open any ML paper and you'll see vectors, matrices, and dot products within the first page. Without linear algebra intuition, those are just symbols.
You don't need to be a mathematician. You need to see what operations mean geometrically — then code them yourself.

steps.title: The dot product measures similarity
steps.body: The dot product tells you how aligned two vectors are: positive means similar direction, zero means perpendicular, negative means opposite. This is the basis of embedding similarity search in AI.
